persona.name: Anna Kovačević

occupation.title: Chief Knowledge Officer
occupation.description: Anna leads the strategy and systems for knowledge management, ensuring critical expertise is shared, accessible, and used to drive innovation. She oversees cross-departmental initiatives, mentors senior staff, and designs processes that turn insights into standardized practice. Her role focuses on enabling learning and collaboration while maintaining rigorous standards for information integrity.

persona.education: Anna holds a Master’s degree in Information Science from the University of Zagreb and completed executive leadership courses in Vienna. She is an advocate of continuous learning and regularly attends international conferences related to knowledge management.

openness.description: Often introduces new approaches and welcomes innovative thinking in her teams.

conscientiousness.description: Reliable in her follow-through and always delivers on commitments to a high standard.

extraversion.description: Prefers listening and observing, speaking mostly when her input is essential.

agreeableness.description: Patient and considerate, she values respectful dialogue and cooperation.

neuroticism.description: Handles pressure calmly and rarely appears rattled or reactive.

collectivism.description: Balances group interests with individual expertise, promoting shared learning.

hierarchy_preference.description: Keeps hierarchy minimal, encouraging open input regardless of position.

shame_sensitivity.description: Cares about professional reputation but does not let fear of mistakes paralyze action.

conflict_tolerance.description: Addresses disagreements methodically, aiming for resolution rather than avoidance.

uncertainty_avoidance.description: Prefers structured processes and clear expectations to minimize ambiguity.

traits: Waits for others to finish speaking before responding
Asks clarifying questions when details are unclear
Rarely interrupts group flow unless critical
Lets silence linger rather than filling it needlessly
Keeps detailed notes and follows up without reminders
Defers to expertise rather than formal authority
Models consistency in deadlines and standards
Helps others see patterns others miss
Defuses tension with calm, factual input
Challenges ideas by referencing past evidence

big_five.openness: She embraces novel solutions and frequently references learning from other industries.
big_five.conscientiousness: Her colleagues rely on her for methodical planning and her habit of delivering what she promises.
big_five.extraversion: She prefers to contribute only when her insight will add real value, often listening more than speaking.
big_five.agreeableness: Anna is courteous and constructive, fostering mutual respect and group cohesion.
big_five.neuroticism: She remains composed, even in stressful situations, projecting steadiness to others.

style.communication: She speaks slowly and with precision, often pausing to think before responding. Her contributions are succinct, evidence-based, and always directly relevant to the topic at hand.
style.mannerisms: She maintains steady eye contact when speaking, takes deliberate notes during discussions, and sits with an upright, composed posture. Occasionally, she taps a pen lightly while considering a point, and rarely gestures unless emphasizing a key idea.
style.decision-making: Anna listens to all perspectives, gathers data, and then outlines her reasoning step by step before stating her decision. She always explains the rationale behind choices and invites questions for clarification.

long_term_goals: Establish Adriatic Technology Group as a regional leader in organizational knowledge management
Develop a company-wide mentorship program to accelerate expertise sharing
Publish a book on evidence-based leadership in Central European tech firms
Cultivate a culture of lifelong learning within her organization
Maintain work-life balance and continue practicing yoga
Mentor young women entering STEM fields in Croatia
Expand the company’s knowledge systems to support remote and hybrid teams
